net.guizhanss.gcereborn

Class GeneticChickengineering

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.bukkit.plugin.PluginBase
      • org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
        • net.guizhanss.gcereborn.GeneticChickengineering
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.SlimefunAddon, org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor, org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter, org.bukkit.command.TabExecutor, org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin

    public class GeneticChickengineering
extends org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
implements io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.SlimefunAddon
    Main plugin class.

    Note: unlike the upstream Reborn build, this does not extend GuizhanLib's AbstractAddon. That class implements the pre-fork SlimefunAddon interface from the package this fork renamed away from; loading it would throw NoClassDefFoundError immediately. GuizhanLib-api's jar is also compiled for Java 16 (class file version 60), which a Java-8 javac cannot even read as a compile-time dependency - so this addon no longer depends on the GuizhanLib-api artifact at all. Instead this plugin implements the fork's SlimefunAddon directly (same approach as SMG/SimpleUtils) and vendors the small, Slimefun-independent pieces of GuizhanLib it used (Scheduler, the command framework, chat/version/localization utils) as plain Java-8 source under net.guizhanss.gcereborn.libs.guizhanlib.

      • autoUpdate

        protected void autoUpdate()
        Implementation Note:
        "Build"-tagged versions self-update only through the optional companion "GuizhanLibPlugin" updater, invoked via reflection so it is never a compile/runtime dependency. GuizhanLib-api's own GuizhanBuildsUpdater fallback is gone now that this addon no longer bundles that jar (see the class javadoc), so "Build" versions without GuizhanLibPlugin installed simply won't self-update.
